def solution():
    # Define variables
    two_year_rate = 0.045
    current_one_year_rate = 0.030

    # Calculate the expected one-year rate next year
    future_one_year_rate = (
        (1 + two_year_rate) ** 2 / (1 + current_one_year_rate)
    ) - 1

    # Convert to percentage and round to two decimal places
    answer = round(future_one_year_rate * 100, 2)

    # Return answer
    return answer
